remarks: Move right into this beautifully maintained 4-bedroom home in the heart of Cos Cob! The first floor offers a wonderful open-concept family room flowing seamlessly into the eat-in kitchen, creating the perfect space for everyday living and entertaining. A formal dining room, full bath, private office, and study complete the main level. Upstairs, you'll find four generously sized bedrooms and two full bathrooms, including access to a walk-up attic from one of the bedrooms, providing excellent storage or future expansion potential. Outside, enjoy a flat backyard and detached two-car garage. Ideally located just moments from parks, shops, restaurants, schools, and the train, this home offers the perfect combination of space, convenience, and lifestyle.
